QuestInfo.name: [Gold Beach] The Day the Lights Went Out
QuestInfo.0: You've been working hard since you reached Gold Beach. It's about time you asked #p1082000# where you'll be staying.
QuestInfo.1: Tell #p1082003# in the #e#m120041100##n that the beach lighting is broken.
QuestInfo.2: You found #p1082003# in the #m120041100#. Tell him about the broken beach lighting.

0.0: How many more of these accursed slimes do I have to deal with?! \r\n#L0##bSo, is there like a room I can rest in, or... #l\n#k
0.1: If today doesn't end soon... We have a problem with the beach lights. I know you're here to 'relax' on your 'vacation', but wouldn't a little bit of manual labor be fun? That's what my vacations always consist of.

yes.0: I will make sure the rest of the staff treats you with the same respect they treat me when this is all done. That means they will leave you alone unless their hair is on fire, at which point they will ask you kindly how to put it out.
yes.1: Let #e#p1082003##n know that the beach lights are broken. He should be making his rounds in the #b#m120041100##k.

no.0: Just say yes. It will be better than wasting away your life on a beach chair.

npc.0: Tell #p1082003# in the #m120041100# that the beach lighting is broken.
